title: Deep Neural Operator Learning for Probabilistic Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.07235v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a deep neural-operator framework for a general class of probabilistic models. Under global Lipschitz conditions on the operator over the entire Euclidean space-and for a broad class of probabilistic models-we establish a universal approximation theorem with explicit network-size bounds for the proposed architecture. The underlying stochastic processes are required only to satisfy integrability and general tail-probability conditions. We verify these assumptions for both European and American option-pricing problems within the forward-backward SDE (FBSDE) framework, which in turn covers a broad class of operators arising from parabolic PDEs, with or without free boundaries. Finally, we present a numerical example for a basket of American options, demonstrating that the learned model produces optimal stopping boundaries for new strike prices without retraining.

translated_title: 概率模型的深度神经算子学习
translated_abstract: 我们为一大类概率模型提出了一个深度神经算子框架。在算子在整个欧几里得空间上满足全局Lipschitz条件的情况下——并且针对一大类概率模型——我们为所提出的架构建立了具有显式网络规模界的通用逼近定理。底层随机过程只需满足可积性和一般的尾概率条件。我们在前向-后向随机微分方程（FBSDE）框架内验证了这些假设对欧式和美式期权定价问题均成立，这进而涵盖了一大类由抛物型偏微分方程产生的算子，无论是否带有自由边界。最后，我们给出了一个美式期权组合的数值例子，表明所学习的模型无需重新训练即可为新的执行价格产生最优停止边界。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个适用于概率模型的深度神经算子框架，建立了具有显式网络规模界的通用逼近定理，并证明所学模型无需重新训练即可为新的执行价格生成美式期权的最优停止边界。
